activity_context.topic_title: The Sum of the First N Terms of a Geometric Series

feedback.problem: What is the sum of the first $N$ terms of a geometric series if the first term is $5$ and the common ratio is $2?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The sum of the first $N$ terms of a geometric series can be determined by the formula

$$
{S}_{N}=\frac{{a}_{1}(1-{r}^{N})}{1-r}.
$$

In this case, ${a}_{1}=5$ and $r=2.$ Therefore, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{N} & =\frac{5(1-{2}^{N})}{1-2} \\  & =-5(1-{2}^{N}) \\  & =5({2}^{N}-1)\end{aligned}
$$
